message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage. I had just settled in with a cup of tea when *poof*—everything went dark! Instead of panicking, I remembered my little stash of flashlights and power banks. I grabbed a flashlight and lit up the room, and my phone was at the ready for updates. It felt so nice to stay cozy without a candle in sight! 

A small win, but it made the evening feel a little more peaceful and a lot less chaotic. 

Have you had a moment like this? What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a blackout? 😊
